name: Nuclear safety and safeguards
payer: Operators fund INPO; states fund IAEA and national regulators.
access: IAEA inspections by state consent; Additional Protocol expands access; INPO peer reviews on site.
publication: INPO reports confidential to the operator and insurers; NRC findings public; IAEA reports to member states.
ai_analogue: Two precedents: separating promotion from regulation (AEC split in 1974), and industry-funded confidential peer review that works because insurance and a public regulator sit behind it.

milestones.event: NPT safeguards agreements give the IAEA inspection rights in signatory states.
Energy Reorganization Act splits the AEC into the NRC (regulation) and ERDA (promotion).
INPO founded: industry-funded peer evaluations with confidential reports tied to insurance.
Iraq's undeclared program discovered after the Gulf War.
Additional Protocol expands IAEA access to undeclared sites and information.
